claim_text: R1 closes the learn-from-errors half of MITAD_A's accountability loop with three reuse-first, read-and-report tools (zero DATA INAMOVIBLE / ledger mutation; reads are free per CLAUDE.md §7). (1) replay_and_regress.py re-executes the deterministic check embedded in a stored case against a changed system Sigma' and reports per-case Delta-v (regression = baseline POSITIVE -> current NEGATIVE). (2) governance_prefilter.py is an advisory, non-blocking pre-filter inserted BEFORE the human gate: it replays records + a regression-case corpus under a proposed Sigma' and reports per-case dominance (Tarski/Goedel: the frozen held-out H is the strictly-higher level; the policy cannot certify itself). It never approves/applies (ADR-0013 self_applied:false intact). (3) build_regression_cases.py turns failure_log.jsonl entries into permanent, self-validated, replay-bearing guards in substrate_calibration/regression_cases/ (additive: each logged error -> one more guard). Verified end-to-end NO-SPEND: the canonical 2026-06 marker-ID corruption (wt1a -> ENSDARG00000054611) is caught as Delta-v=-1.0 via a REAL guard auto-built from the failure log; a regressive store/rule proposal is FAILed pre-gate; a clean one PASSes.
